entries.en: The Council also owes you a great personal debt, Commander. One we can never repay.
You saved not just our lives, but the lives of billions from Sovereign and the Reapers.
We will need a list of potential candidates to fill humanity's seat on the Council.
Given all that has happened, I am sure your recommendation will carry a great deal of weight, Commander. Do you support any particular candidate?
Well, the ambassador has worked with the Council in the past, and we are familiar with his style and methods.
A little too familiar, you could say.
Oh, you haven't seen anything yet, Councilor. I've been holding back.
I am certain we will all learn to work together in time.
You trying to make me blush, Shepard?
Are you sure about this, Commander? The captain is a soldier, not a politician.
I think it's an inspired choice. The Council would welcome him with open arms, should he accept.
I'm honored, Councilor. As humanity's representative, I'll do everything in my power to help the Council rebuild.
I agree with the commander. This is too important to rush into.
Of course, Ambassador. We will welcome your candidates with open arms, whomever they may be.
I want a true advocate for humanity on the Council. Someone who will protect the interests of our species no matter what. I want Udina.
We need someone with the courage to stand up for what he believes in. Someone like Captain Anderson.
You're right. We need someone with diplomatic experience. Someone like you, Ambassador.
I'd rather have the captain on the Council than any politician I know.
We've already got too many politicians on the Citadel. The captain would be perfect for this job.
Let the politicians figure this one out.
Sovereign was only a vanguard. The Reaper fleet is still coming. Hundreds of ships, maybe thousands. And I'm going to find some way to stop them!
It's not up to me.
Then I pick you.
I'm not picking you!
That's the point.
The Reapers will return.
Ambassador. Captain. Commander Shepard.
We have gathered here to recognize the enormous contributions of the Alliance forces in the war against Sovereign and the geth.
Many humans lost their lives in the battle to save the Citadel, brave and courageous soldiers who willingly gave their lives so that we--the Council--might live.
There is no greater sacrifice, and we share your grief over the tragic loss of so many noble men and women.
Commander Shepard, your heroic and selfless actions serve as a symbol of everything humanity and the Alliance stand for.
And though we cannot bring back those valiant soldiers who gave their lives to save ours, we can honor their memories through our actions.
Humanity has shown it is ready to stand as a defender and protector of the galaxy. You have proved you are worthy to join our ranks and serve beside us on the Citadel Council.
Councilor, on behalf of humanity and the Alliance, we thank you for this prestigious honor and humbly accept.
Him? You must be joking. Anderson prefers to let his fists do the talking.
Only with you, Ambassador. Only with you.
Sovereign's defeat marks the beginning of a new era for both humanity and the Council.
Shepard's right. Humanity is ready to do its part. United with the rest of the Council, we have the strength to overcome any challenge.
When the Reapers come we must stand side by side. We must fight against them as one. And together we will drive them back into dark space!
When the Reapers come, we must stand side by side. We must fight against them as one. And together we will drive them back into dark space!
Many humans lost their lives in the battle to save the Citadel, brave and courageous soldiers who willingly gave their lives so that we--the Council--might live.
The Council also owes you a great personal debt, Commander. One we can never repay. By defeating Sovereign, you have saved billions of lives.
You have the courage of your convictions and a ruthless determination to succeed. Through your actions, you have become a symbol of everything humanity represents.
Your species has an indomitable will, a fierce, savage spirit that will not bend or yield. We used to believe this made humans stubborn, even dangerous.
But now we understand that these traits are what make you strong. There are dark times ahead; the Council needs humanity and its strength.
As the Alliance ambassador, I accept your offer. Humanity will join its strength to yours. We will take our seat on the Council.
We will need a list of potential candidates.
The ambassador is the obvious choice. There are hard times ahead; he is a man capable of doing what needs to be done.
The shadow of war darkens our future; selecting someone with military experience is a wise choice.
I'm honored, Councilor. As humanity's representative, I'll do everything in my power to help guide the Council.
The battle with Sovereign destroyed our illusions of peace and security. Now the galaxy will look to us--the Council--to defend them.
Shepard's right. We're on the verge of war with an enemy unlike any the galaxy has ever known; a war for the very survival of all life as we know it.
Humanity is ready to do its part. We will not back down. We will not surrender. We will lead you into battle against the Reapers and we will drive them back into dark space!
Don't start patting yourselves on the back just yet. Sovereign wasn't alone. The rest of the Reapers are still out there. And I'm going to find some way to stop them!
Sovereign alone nearly wiped you out. You won't stand a chance if the whole Reaper fleet shows up. Not unless I find some way to stop them!
This isn't over yet.
I've got work to do.
It won't be easy.
This is far from over.
You're not ready!
These are strange times, Captain. The battle with Sovereign changed everything. And we need to talk about what happened to the Council.
We got your message, Ambassador. What's all this about?
No need to get worked up, Captain. I'd like to end this meeting with all my teeth still in place.
You should thank me for what I did. If the Normandy was still grounded, we'd all be dead right now!
I understand, Captain. You did what you had to do. That's not why you're here. We need to talk about what happened to the Council.
Commander Shepard did the right thing. We had to hold our fleet back to go after Sovereign. It was the only way.
I agree, but this also presents us with an opportunity. The Council is dead. The galaxy is looking for leadership.
The Citadel fleets were decimated in the attack. Their losses have made the Alliance stronger. If we step forward now, nobody will be able to stop us!
Noble words, but your actions tell the real story. Ever since you became a Spectre, I've been watching you, Shepard. You're completely ruthless.
Good God, Shepard! How can you even say that?
Don't act so surprised, Captain. We all know it's true.
Sacrificing the Council assured our victory over Sovereign. The end justified the means. We humans understand that. It's what makes us stronger than the others.
What are you saying?
The galaxy needs leadership. Real leadership. When a crisis hits, we can't be paralyzed by debate like the old Council.
The new Council must rule with a single voice. It must be assembled from one species alone -- humanity!
The other species are scared. They've never faced anything like this before and they don't know what to do. They want us to step forward. They believe in humanity because of you.
Your ruthless pursuit of Saren and the geth, your defiance of the Council -- that's what humans are capable of! That's how we can defeat the Reapers!
The others will follow us, Shepard. They know we're their only hope. We will have a human Council with a human Chairman.
The ambassador's right. I may not like it, but we can't deny the truth.
Given everything you've done, Commander, the Alliance will want to know who you think our Chairman should be.
He is the logical choice. So what happens now?
You make a good case. Captain, are you ready for this?
I don't know if any of us are ready for this. But I'll do what I can.
So what happens now?
Shepard's right. We're headed for war with the Reapers. If we lose, it's the end of all life as we know it. And no other species in the galaxy truly understands what it will take to survive.
The other races have to follow our lead. We need to take control. It's time for humanity to rise up and seize its destiny!
You should be thanking me for what I did. If the Normandy was still grounded we'd all be dead right now!
I agree... but this also presents us with an opportunity. The Citadel fleets were decimated in the attack. Their losses have made the Alliance stronger.
They can't rebuild without us. We need to take the lead in forming a new Council. One with a human chairman at its head.
The other species are scared. They've never faced anything like this before. They don't know what to do. They want us to step forward.
They believe in us because of you, Shepard. You saved the galaxy from Sovereign. You're a symbol of everything good about humanity: our courage; our strength.
The ambassador's right. The other races look up to us now. They won't just accept our leadership; they'll welcome it.
Given everything you've done, Commander, the Alliance will want to know who you think our Council Chairman should be.
Shepard's right. We're headed for war with the Reapers. If we lose it's the end of all life as we know it. We have to show the rest of the galaxy what it takes to survive.
With the support of the other races, we can win this battle. With them behind us, we can stand against the Reapers' return... and drive them back into dark space!
Shepard's right. We're headed for war with the Reapers. If we lose, it's the end of all life as we know it. We have to show the rest of the galaxy what it takes to survive.
This wasn't some plan for the Alliance to seize power! We need to work with the other races to rebuild.
You have a plan?
The Council was always holding us back. When I saw the opportunity to get rid of them, I took it.
We need to work together with the other species! It's the only way we can stand against the Reapers!
The rest of the galaxy isn't just going to bow down because we tell them to.
We need someone who understands how politics really works. You've shown you know how to play this game.
We're about to go into war. We need someone with military experience. Someone like Captain Anderson.
The Reapers are still out there. They're coming. And I'm going to find some way to stop them.
You two can argue politics all you want. But the Reapers are still out there. They're coming. And I'm going to find some way to stop them!
Let the politicians figure this one out. I've got real work to do. The Reapers are still out there. And I'm going to find some way to stop them.
This wasn't some plan for the Alliance to seize power! Forcing the other races to accept our leadership is going to cause problems.
I can see the other races inviting us to join the Council. But lead it? That's a whole different story.
The other species won't like this. We'll need our fleets to bring them in line.
We need someone who understands how politics work. Someone used to dealing with the other species. Someone like you, Ambassador.
You two can handle the political end. But the Reapers are still out there. They're coming. And I'm going to find some way to stop them!
We should restore the Council.
What are you suggesting?
That's why I did it.
This isn't right.
They won't like this.
I don't care.
Now the real work begins.
We need to get started.
We quit wasting time.
This doesn't seem right.
Will they accept that?
We need to use force.
The rest of the galaxy isn't just going to bow down just because we tell them to. We'll need the fleets to bring them in line.
We'll need to use force.
Not now, Commander!
Take out those hostiles!
I'm a little busy here!
Not in the middle of a fight!
Now is not the time!
We are in the middle of a fight!
Not now, Shepard!
